methodologyNotes: Covers residential ductless mini-split heat pump systems (matched outdoor condenser plus wall-mounted indoor air handler) sold in the US at a published MSRP or typical street price. Scope is single-zone wall-mount systems; specs are quoted for the most commonly sold nominal size (usually the 12,000 BTU/h model in a family) so cross-brand rows compare like for like. Excludes air-conditioning-only (non-heat-pump) units, window/portable units, multi-zone-only condensers, ceiling-cassette and floor-console indoor styles, and central ducted air handlers. Price is US MSRP or typical system street price in USD (indoor + outdoor unit). coolingCapacityBtu is nominal rated cooling capacity in BTU/h. heatingCapacityBtu is nominal rated heating capacity in BTU/h at 47F. seer2 is the SEER2 cooling seasonal efficiency rating (higher is better); where only legacy SEER is published it is noted in provenance. hspf2 is the HSPF2 heating seasonal efficiency rating (higher is better). eer2 is the EER2 full-load cooling efficiency rating. zones is the number of indoor zones the outdoor unit supports (count; 1 = single-zone). voltageV is nominal supply voltage as an enum, 115 or 230. minHeatingTempCelsius is the lowest outdoor temperature at which the system is rated to produce heat, in degrees C (lower is better; null if not disclosed). indoorSoundMinDb is the minimum indoor-unit sound pressure level on the lowest fan speed in dB(A). refrigerantType is the charged refrigerant as an enum (e.g. R-410A, R-32, R-454B). energyStarCertified is a boolean for current ENERGY STAR listing of the referenced size.

products.name: LG Art Cool Premier LA120HYV
products.priceNote: No US MSRP or full-system street price for the LA120HYV was found on any fetchable page (retailer pages at ecomfort, ajmadison, and supplyhouse all returned HTTP 403). The only figure encountered was $249 on splitairconditioningunit.com, an aggregator placeholder repeated identically across five 'trusted sellers' and tied to a mixed LA120HYV1 listing — not a credible full ductless-system price — so priceUsd is left null.
products.provenance: The LG submittal data sheet (DFS-SB-AG-004-US, hosted on ManualsLib) confirms this is the exact base model LA120HYV — Art Cool Premier Single Zone Inverter, outdoor unit LAU120HYV and indoor unit LAN120HYV (no suffix) — and lists 12,000 Btu/h cooling, 13,600 Btu/h heating, R410A refrigerant, 208-230V/60Hz/1ph supply, and IDU sound pressure of 42/36/25/17 dB(A) (17 dB(A) minimum in sleep mode). It publishes only legacy SEER 25.5 / EER 14.1 / HSPF 11.5, not SEER2/EER2/HSPF2, so those three efficiency fields are left null; heating operating range is given only in °F (-13°F) with no stated °C value, so minHeatingTempCelsius is null. splitairconditioningunit.com corroborates the same base-model identity and specs (System Model LA120HYV, Indoor LAN120HYV, Outdoor LAU120HYV, 12,000/13,600 BTU, 25.5 SEER, 14.1 EER, 11.5 HSPF, 230/208V); no credible US MSRP was found on any fetchable page, so priceUsd is null.

products.name: Pioneer Diamante WYS012AMFI20RL
products.priceNote: Pioneer Official Store (manufacturer, source) lists the regular price (MSRP) as $1,029.00 for SKU WYS012AMFI20RL-10, shown verbatim as "Regular price $1,029.00" with a sale price of $823.00; the listing is now marked DISCONTINUED/Out of Stock due to the R-410A phaseout. Your Grow Depot (corroboration) lists the in-market WYS012AMFI20RL-16 at "Regular price $868.00". priceUsd uses the manufacturer MSRP $1,029.00.
products.provenance: Both fetched pages are for the exact model WYS012AMFI20RL: the Pioneer Official Store (manufacturer) lists SKU WYS012AMFI20RL-10 and Your Grow Depot lists item number WYS012AMFI20RL-16 — the same base model, with the suffix denoting the copper line-kit length. The manufacturer page states verbatim the Performance Data: Cooling/Heating Rated Capacity 12,000 BTU/h, Cooling SEER2 20.8, EER2 10.3, Heating HSPF2 (Region IV) 8.7, Refrigerant Type R410A/30, Power Supply 110~120V, and indoor Sound Level (Lo) 26.0 dB(A); it lists the regular MSRP at $1,029.00 (sale $823.00) and is now discontinued due to the R-410A phaseout. Your Grow Depot corroborates every spec value identically and lists the same model at $868.00. No minimum heating operating temperature or ENERGY STAR listing is stated on either page, so those are left null.

products.name: Senville LETO SENL-12CD
products.priceNote: Senville.com manufacturer store lists the SENL-12CD (16 ft. installation kit configuration) at "Now $USD: $799.99" (MSRP field blank). Home Outlet Direct lists the same SKU at "Sale price $949.99 / Regular price $1,239.99"; the $799.99 manufacturer-store price is used as the US price.
products.provenance: The Senville manufacturer product page confirms Model Number SENL-12CD, a 115V/1Ph/60Hz single-zone 12,000 BTU LETO-series ductless mini-split heat pump, priced at "Now $USD: $799.99", with a full spec table: SEER2 21.2, EER2 10.1, cooling/heating capacity 12000 BTU, HSPF2-4 (Region IV) 8.7, indoor noise down to 17.5 dB(A), R454B refrigerant, and heating rated to -15C (5F). Home Outlet Direct's retailer listing for the identical SKU (SENL-12CD) corroborates every figure verbatim (21.2 SEER2, 115V, 12000 BTU cooling and heating, EER2 10.1, HSPF2-4 8.7, indoor noise 45.0/40.5/32.5/25.0/17.5 dB, R454B, -15C). Neither page lists an ENERGY STAR certification (they cite AHRI, UL and EnergyGuide only), so energyStarCertified is left null; no release year is stated on either page.

products.name: Cooper & Hunter Sophia CH-12SPH-115
products.priceNote: AC-World lists the CH-12SPH-115VI/CH-12SPH-115VO system (indoor + outdoor) at "$970.00" — used as the typical system street price. MiniSplitsForLess lists the same exact system (no kit) at "$583.10" but marked "Sold out" (clearance). No manufacturer MSRP was fetchable (cooperandhunter.us returned HTTP 403).
products.provenance: The AC-World page is the exact-model listing (Product #: CH-12SPH-115VI/CH-12SPH-115VO, the Sophia 115V 12,000 BTU system) and confirms 12000 BTU cooling, 12500 BTU heating, 115 V single-phase, R410A pre-charge, and a system price of $970.00. The manufacturer page (cooperandhunter.us) returned HTTP 403, so the exact-model MiniSplitsForLess listing (SKU CH-12SPH-115VO12SPH) is used as corroboration; it labels the unit "SEER2 21.5," 115V, R410A, Single Zone at a $583.10 clearance price (sold out, no kit). Note the efficiency labeling differs — AC-World says "SEER 21.5" while MiniSplitsForLess says "SEER2 21.5" — and HSPF2, EER2, indoor sound, min heating temp, and ENERGY STAR were left null because they are not published for this exact model on either page (the MiniSplitsForLess detailed spec table belongs to the Olivia series, not the Sophia CH-12SPH).
